notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts with haste.
When the token Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Conscripts trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Zealous Conscripts.
Repeat.
